{
  "verdict": "fix",
  "issues": [
    "No PATCH endpoint for partial updates; PUT requires full resource replacement, which is inefficient and may cause data loss.",
    "No versioning strategy (e.g., /v1/tasks) increases risk of breaking changes for clients.",
    "The UpdateTaskRequest definition requires all fields (title, description, status) to be provided, making it inflexible for partial updates.",
    "The ErrorResponse type is too simplistic; it does not include machine-readable codes or field-level validation errors.",
    "The API lacks pagination, filtering, or sorting for the GET /tasks collection endpoint, which could lead to performance issues with large datasets."
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    "Add a PATCH endpoint to support partial updates of tasks.",
    "Introduce API versioning (e.g., /v1/tasks) to manage future changes without breaking existing clients.",
    "Make fields optional in UpdateTaskRequest to align with partial update semantics if PATCH is added.",
    "Enhance the ErrorResponse structure to include a code and details field for better error handling.",
    "Implement query parameters (e.g., ?status=pending&page=1&limit=20) for filtering, pagination, and sorting on the collection endpoint."
  ]
}
